messages:
Maya: Hey infra — need to provision a small bursty GPU node pool in us-east1 for a new inference endpoint. Goal: cost-conscious, mostly A10G, preemptible ok. Steady 1-2 nodes, peak up to 8. Who can take quota request + nodepool spec? cc @Kevin @Liam

Kevin: I can own the quota request. Quick Q: is us-east1 required? we have more quota headroom in us-central1 but latency to our customers is slightly higher.

Maya: us-east1 preferred due to regional traffic. If quota takes longer, failover to us-central1 is acceptable.

Liam: For A10G preemptible, suggest nodepool settings: min=1, max=8, autoscaler with scale-down delay 10m, CPU/GPU resource-based scaling. Taints so only inference pods land there: node taint inference=gpu:NoSchedule and add toleration to daemonset or deployment.

Liam: Example gcloud command (GKE) I usually run:```bash
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-burst-a10g
  --cluster=redwood-prod-cluster
  --region=us-east1
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10g,count=1
  --num-nodes=1
  --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=8
  --enable-autoscaling
  --preemptible
  --node-taints=inference=gpu:NoSchedule
```

Priya: For quota request include project id and exact GPU type/count. I'll file with cloud support once Kevin drops the numbers. Also want to confirm we have GPU driver DaemonSet + device-plugin in that cluster already?

Maya: Project: redwood-prod-001. Target initial quota: 10 A10G GPUs (we want headroom).

Kevin: Filing quota request now. Request text: "Increase NVIDIA A10 GPU quota in us-east1 to 20 (project redwood-prod-001) — for burst inference nodepool. Will use preemptible nodes and autoscaling. Contact Kevin for follow-up." I'll attach expected CPU/ram per node.

Liam: Driver note: cluster already has nvidia-driver-installer DS in kube-system but it's on a per-node image path. For preemptible pools ensure the DaemonSet tolerates the taint or we set the nodepool label and run a separate DL driver DS targeting that label.

Liam: Also watch out for GPU eviction churn on preemptible — add PodDisruptionBudget for critical pods and use a small buffer (min spare 1) in autoscaler if you need continuous SLA. Suggest autoscaler config:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: ca-gpu-burst
spec:
  scaleDown:
    delayAfterAdd: 10m
    delayAfterDelete: 1m
  policies:
    - type: LowNodeUtilization
      parameters:
        nodeUtilizationThreshold: 0.5
```

Maya: Good call on PDB + buffer. We'll mark critical pods with priorityClass=system-cluster-critical so they get moved before less-critical workload.

Priya: Kevin — once quota request lands, add Cloud Console link and ticket number here. Also include estimated monthly cost with preemptible vs non-preemptible (rough). Finance needs a ballpark.

Kevin: Quota ticket created: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-prod-001 (ticket #Q-4217). Requested A10G quota->20 in us-east1. ETA from cloud support ~48-72h. :thumbsup:

Liam: Cost note — A10G preemptible ~0.2-0.25x on-demand. If you want cheaper bursts consider mixture: 6 preemptible + 2 on-demand for buffer. Also check node local SSD I/O if throughput-heavy models.

Maya: We'll start with 6 preemptible + 2 on-demand plan. Kevin, when quota approved I can kick off nodepool create and deploy inference canary.

InfraBot: Reminder: please add taint key inference and label pool=gpu-burst to nodepool creation request. Auto-tagging rule will pick it up for cost center=ml-inference.

Kevin: Ticket updated with approval notes (pending). I also requested increase to persistent GPUs to 30 in us-east1 in case we add another pool next quarter.

Maya: Perfect. After nodepool is up, I'll run these quick checks: `kubectl describe nodes -l pool=gpu-burst`, `nvidia-smi` on a pod shell, and a 5-minute load test to validate scaling.

Liam: If you want I can script the validation and a small terraform module for the nodepool so it's repeatable.

Maya: Please do. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
